summary: Zoom's main friction themes are: **Security & Privacy Concerns**, **User Experience & Interface Issues**, **Technical Reliability & Performance**, and **Feature Limitations**.

themes.name: User Experience & Interface Issues
themes.description: Users report difficulties with navigation, zoom functionality, and inconsistent UI behavior across devices.
themes.recommendation: Simplify UI, improve zoom controls, and ensure cross-device consistency.

themes.name: Feature Limitations
themes.description: Users request more customization, better screen sharing, and improved collaboration tools.
themes.recommendation: Add customization options, enhance screen sharing, and improve collaboration features.

themes.name: Technical Reliability & Performance
themes.description: Users face issues with app crashes, subscription cancellation problems, and poor performance on older devices.
themes.recommendation: Stabilize app performance, simplify subscription management, and optimize for older hardware.

themes.name: Security & Privacy Concerns
themes.description: Users express concerns about privacy, security, and data handling, including unauthorized access, data leaks, and lack of transparency in data usage.
themes.recommendation: Enhance transparency, improve encryption, and provide clearer privacy controls.
